_meta.description: The NYS Open Legislation MCP server's tool schemas, as its tools/list returns them at the pinned version. The router's NYS Open Legislation entry carries the same schemas as code.
_meta.install: npm install --ignore-scripts into a fresh directory under the OS temporary directory; the server started over stdio with an environment of one variable, NYS_LEGISLATION_API_KEY, set to a placeholder that is not a key

tools.name: search_bills
tools.description: Search NYS legislation by keyword using ElasticSearch syntax. Searches bill titles, summaries, and full text. Supports boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT), phrase quotes, wildcards, and field targeting (e.g. title:"climate" AND sponsor:Krueger). Optionally filter by session year (odd-numbered years: 2023, 2025, etc.).

term.description: Search term or ElasticSearch query string

session_year.description: Legislative session year (odd-numbered, e.g. 2025). Omit to search all sessions (all sessions in the local corpus, when it answers).

tools.name: get_bill
tools.description: Get a specific NYS bill by print number and session year. Print numbers are in the format S1234 (Senate) or A1234 (Assembly). Returns full bill details including status, sponsor, summary, actions, and votes.

session_year.description: Session year (odd-numbered, e.g. 2025). Defaults to current session.

tools.name: list_bills
tools.description: List bills introduced in a given NYS legislative session year, in order of introduction.

session_year.description: Session year (odd-numbered, e.g. 2025). Defaults to current session.

tools.name: get_bill_votes
tools.description: Get all recorded votes on a specific NYS bill, including committee and floor votes. Returns each member's vote grouped by vote code (AYE, NAY, EXC, ABS, etc.). These are the `votes` from the bill record; a bill with no recorded votes returns an empty list.

session_year.description: Session year (odd-numbered, e.g. 2025). Defaults to current session.

tools.name: get_bill_updates
tools.description: Get a feed of bill changes within a date range — useful for tracking what was introduced, amended, or acted on during a specific period.

tools.name: list_laws
tools.description: List all law bodies in New York State — the Consolidated Laws, the NYC Administrative Code, the state Constitution, and other codified bodies. Returns law IDs and names.

tools.name: get_law_tree
tools.description: Get the hierarchical table of contents for a specific NYS law body. Use list_laws to find the law ID (e.g. 'EDN' for Education Law, 'LAB' for Labor Law). Returns the document tree with titles and location IDs for each section.

law_id.description: Law body identifier, e.g. 'EDN' (Education), 'LAB' (Labor), 'ENV' (Environmental). Use list_laws to find IDs.

tools.name: get_law_section
tools.description: Get the text of a specific section within an NYS law body. Use get_law_tree to find the location ID for the section you need.

location_id.description: Section location ID from the law tree, e.g. 'A1S1' or '701'

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List all members of the NYS Senate or Assembly for a given session year. Returns member IDs, names, districts, and contact information.

chamber.description: Which chamber to list (senate or assembly)

session_year.description: Session year (odd-numbered, e.g. 2025). Defaults to current session.

tools.name: get_member
tools.description: Get a specific NYS legislator by their member ID. Returns full profile including name, district, contact info, and party. Errors if the member sits in the other chamber from `chamber`.

member_id.description: Numeric member ID (from list_members or search_members)

chamber.description: Which chamber the member belongs to

session_year.description: Session year (odd-numbered, e.g. 2025). Defaults to current session.

tools.name: search_members
tools.description: Search for NYS legislators by name. Every result carries `chamber`, and `fullName` where known (a locally served member who has never prime-sponsored a bill has none), so similar names can be told apart. Optionally filter by chamber or session year. Served from the local corpus when present (substring match on short and full name, works without an API key); otherwise, or when nothing matches locally, from the live API, where ElasticSearch field queries such as 'districtCode:20' also work.

session_year.description: Session year (odd-numbered, e.g. 2025). Defaults to current session.

tools.name: list_committees
tools.description: List all committees in the NYS Senate or Assembly for a given session year.

session_year.description: Session year (odd-numbered, e.g. 2025). Defaults to current session.

tools.name: get_committee
tools.description: Get details for a specific NYS committee — chair, meeting schedule, location, and subcommittees.

chamber.description: Which chamber the committee belongs to

session_year.description: Session year (odd-numbered, e.g. 2025). Defaults to current session.

tools.name: get_committee_meetings
tools.description: Get the meeting history and upcoming meetings for a specific NYS committee, including bills considered at each meeting.

chamber.description: Which chamber the committee belongs to

session_year.description: Session year (odd-numbered, e.g. 2025). Defaults to current session.

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.description: List Senate floor calendars for a given year. Floor calendars show which bills are scheduled for floor votes.

year.description: Calendar year (e.g. 2025). Defaults to current year.

tools.name: get_calendar
tools.description: Get a specific Senate floor calendar by year and calendar number. Returns active lists and supplemental calendars showing bills scheduled for floor votes.

tools.name: list_agendas
tools.description: List committee agendas for a given year. Agendas show committee meeting schedules and which bills were considered.

year.description: Calendar year (e.g. 2025). Defaults to current year.

tools.name: get_agenda
tools.description: Get a specific committee agenda by year and agenda number. Returns committee meetings, bills considered, and vote records.

tools.name: list_floor_transcripts
tools.description: List NYS Senate floor session transcripts for a given year.

year.description: Year of the transcripts (e.g. 2025). Defaults to current year.

tools.name: get_floor_transcript
tools.description: Get a specific NYS Senate floor session transcript by its datetime. Use list_floor_transcripts to find datetime values.

tools.name: list_hearing_transcripts
tools.description: List NYS Senate public hearing transcripts for a given year.

year.description: Year of the transcripts (e.g. 2025). Defaults to current year.

tools.name: get_hearing_transcript
tools.description: Get a specific NYS Senate public hearing transcript by its filename. Use list_hearing_transcripts to find filenames.

tools.name: get_updates
tools.description: Get aggregate updates across all NYS Open Legislation content types for a date range. Useful for polling what changed — new bills, amendments, votes, agendas, etc. Optionally restrict to one content type via content_type: bills, agendas, calendars, laws.

type.description: Which timestamp the date range filters on: 'processed' (when Open Legislation processed the change) or 'published' (when the source data was published). Not a content-type filter — use content_type for that. (optional)

content_type.description: Restrict results to one content type (optional)

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search within one NYS Open Legislation content type using ElasticSearch syntax. The upstream API has no unified search endpoint — each content type is searched separately, so this tool searches a single type per call (defaults to bills). Supported types: bills, laws, agendas, calendars, transcripts, hearings. Supports boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT), phrase quotes, wildcards, and field targeting. To search resolutions, use type 'bills' (they share the bills index).

type.description: Content type to search: bills (default), laws, agendas, calendars, transcripts, hearings. One type per call.

session_year.description: Filter bills to a specific session year (optional)
